description.en: The object representing the pipeline execution.
Specifies whether to force the update. If set to `true`, the request overwrites the current pipeline regardless of its version.

descriptions.zh: API提供了乐观锁机制，在不设置强制更新的场景下，需要基于最新的流水线触发器配置修改后提交，否则将触发提交冲突异常。
descriptions.en: This API uses optimistic locking to prevent conflicting updates. If you omit the `force` parameter, the request must use the latest pipeline version. Submitting a request with an outdated version causes a conflict error.
